## Purpose

This is a public notice to **Max Qian / AstroAir** and any other Night Owl rights holder or former maintainer.

A previous preservation repository, https://github.com/mspirek/obsidian-night-owl, carried this same invitation as issue #1 from 2026-08-10. That notice named September 9, 2026 as the earliest Community directory date. No response was received. That previous repository is retired.

The former upstream, https://github.com/AstroAir/obsidian-night-owl, and its owner account are currently unavailable. Night Owl was re-added to Obsidian's official registry under Max Qian/AstroAir and was later removed in an automated registry update.

This repository preserves the recovered Night Owl CSS unchanged and lists the theme as **Night Owl Classic**. Full source, hash, attribution, and license-evidence details are in NOTICE.md. The previous notice text is in docs/PREVIOUS_REPO_CONTACT.md.

## Invitation to respond

If you are the original maintainer or another rights holder, please comment here if you want to:

- reclaim or transfer the project
- request removal or another change to this preservation copy
- approve continued community maintenance
- provide the deleted repository's exact license notice
- correct any provenance or attribution detail

Any response and the resulting maintenance decision will be documented publicly here. Thank you.
